scope: Implementation-bound reuse review and synthetic core/adapter tests; not full workflow or publication qualification.

boundaries.name: confidence_routing
boundaries.contract: Aligned finite numeric vectors, confidence in [0,1], boolean alternate eligibility, common higher-is-better utility scale, nonnegative weights with positive total, explicit finite threshold grid in [0,1]. Numeric inputs become float64. Equality retains the primary route; utility ties choose the smallest threshold.
boundaries.transfer: Constructed manufacturing classification utility and energy-dispatch negative-cost utility exercise the same implementation with an independent scalar score oracle.
boundaries.limitation: The domain adapter supplies eligibility, utility units, validation independence and deployment mixture. Optimality covers only the supplied grid. Calibration utility is not an unbiased performance estimate; lower-precision boundary comparisons require separate qualification.

boundaries.name: component_metric
boundaries.contract: Generic aligned integer component labels and explicit sample/component weights produce additive macro-recall utilities. The grapheme adapter owns 168/11/8 decoding, consonant 7-to-2 correction, canonical 168/11/7 truth bounds and 2:1:1 metric weights.
boundaries.transfer: Component recall can apply to other discrete multi-component outputs under an explicit ontology and weighting policy; the fixed grapheme decoder must be replaced for a different vocabulary.
boundaries.limitation: Per-row utilities already include the metric sample weights; calibration must not apply those weights twice. Metric equivalence is tested with independent route-then-score calculations, not real application quality.

boundaries.name: population_and_class_membership
boundaries.contract: Validated grayscale uint8 populations and aligned joint-class labels; B7 images remain 137 by 236 and are replicated into RGB with caller-supplied channel normalization. The separate font/GAN path crops six columns from each side, resizes to 224 by 224 and uses sequential divide-by-255, subtract-0.5, divide-by-0.5 normalization. Seen membership is an explicit 14784-entry boolean mask; OOD training uses a caller mapping into 1295 classes.
boundaries.transfer: Image-to-symbol applications need their own label ontology, class-membership provenance, image geometry and acquisition normalization. No general image modality or arbitrary class-count support is inferred.
boundaries.limitation: Separating calibration and query graph inputs does not prove population independence. Callers must prevent training/calibration/query leakage and justify unseen-class membership. Font-only synthetic classes test routing structure, not zero-shot accuracy.

boundaries.name: training_and_checkpoint_state
boundaries.contract: Separate B7 OOD/seen fits, two font-classifier fits and two guided CycleGAN fits expose model-state handoffs. Checkpoint digests are verified before fresh tensor-only restoration; frozen classifiers remain fixed while generator gradients flow through them.
boundaries.transfer: The directed combination of classification, domain translation and confidence routing is a reusable recipe when font-like target domains, label preservation and valid confidence semantics are independently justified.
boundaries.limitation: Current adapters have fixed architectures and class widths. Checkpoint paths require a provisioned trusted local filesystem; model-only checkpoints do not resume optimizer/RNG history. Explicit training policies and candidate pretrained initialization do not authenticate exact historical winner choices.

boundaries.name: score_and_ensemble_semantics
boundaries.contract: Finite aligned CPU float32 logits use 1295 OOD and 14784 seen/unseen classes. OOD confidence is maximum sigmoid; seen selection applies softmax then joint argmax. Two font branches separately softmax and marginalize before component selection; low-confidence alternate predictions fall back to seen when alternate class membership is known.
boundaries.transfer: Class confidence, ontology-preserving marginalization and fallback rules must be supplied and evaluated for each application. The generic confidence core does not infer these meanings.
boundaries.limitation: Maximum sigmoid is not calibrated uncertainty. Independent component maxima may form a joint class neither model selected directly. Seen decoding is an explicit reconstruction choice, and float32 softmax tie behavior is retained.

boundaries.name: graph_and_selection
boundaries.contract: Twenty-two nodes separate all six fits, calibration/query inference, score extraction, two-font ensemble, threshold fitting, routing and output conversion. Fourteen provider callables use trusted object boundaries and lightweight kind witnesses.
boundaries.transfer: Selection must use computational applicability and declared adapter assumptions independently of competition provenance. Generic routing reuse does not qualify every recipe stage for standalone cross-disciplinary selection.
boundaries.limitation: Object ports and kind witnesses alone do not establish shapes, population alignment, resource safety or catalog eligibility. Full execution, source/license review, complete catalog port constraints and transactional publication remain separate requirements.

reuse_decision: Expose confidence routing and component-recall computation separately from fixed grapheme ontologies and font-model adapters. Transfer of the complete recipe remains conditional on target-domain semantics, label preservation, confidence behavior and independent population evaluation.
